name: PC gaming launchers
author: RusTV
description: Open your PC game launchers from the couch: Epic Games, GOG Galaxy, Xbox app and Battle.net.
details: Adds native tiles for four Windows game launchers through their URI schemes: Epic Games Launcher, GOG Galaxy, the Xbox app and Battle.net. Each launcher must already be installed; the tile only opens it. Steam Big Picture is already built into RusTV. Needs the launch permission.

dependencies.name: Epic Games Launcher
dependencies.note: Required for the Epic Games tile

dependencies.note: Required for the GOG Galaxy tile

dependencies.name: Xbox app
dependencies.note: Required for the Xbox app tile

fr.name: Lanceurs de jeux PC
fr.description: Ouvrez vos lanceurs de jeux PC depuis le canapé : Epic Games, GOG Galaxy, app Xbox et Battle.net.
fr.details: Ajoute des tuiles natives pour quatre lanceurs Windows via leurs schémas d'URI : Epic Games Launcher, GOG Galaxy, l'app Xbox et Battle.net. Chaque lanceur doit déjà être installé ; la tuile ne fait que l'ouvrir. Steam Big Picture est déjà intégré à RusTV. Nécessite la permission launch.
